module RAM #(
    parameter WIDTH=6,
    parameter DEPTH=8
) (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input write_en,
    input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]write_addr,
    input [WIDTH-1:0]write_data,
    input read_en,
    input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]read_addr,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]read_data
);

reg [5:0] RAM [2**6-1:0];

integer i;
initial begin
	for(i = 0; i < 2**6; i = i + 1) begin
		RAM[i] = 6'b000000;
	end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (!rst_n) begin
		
		for(i = 0; i < 2**6; i = i + 1) begin
			RAM[i] <= 6'b000000;
		end
	end else if (write_en) begin
		
		RAM[write_addr] <= write_data;
	end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (!rst_n) begin
		
		read_data <= 6'b000000;
	end else if (read_en) begin
		
		read_data <= RAM[read_addr];
	end else begin
		
		read_data <= 6'b000000;
	end
end
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="RAM">
    <description>A dual-port RAM with a depth of 8 and a bit width of 6, initialized with all zeros.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="write_en">Write enable signal for initiating a write operation.</input>
        <input id="write_addr" width_description="[5:0]">Address for the write operation.</input>
        <input id="write_data" width_description="[5:0]">Data to be written to the RAM.</input>
        <input id="read_en">Read enable signal for initiating a read operation.</input>
        <input id="read_addr" width_description="[5:0]">Address for the read operation.</input>
        <output id="read_data" width_description="[5:0]">Output data read from the RAM.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">6</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">8</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <reg id="read_data" width_description="[5:0]">Register to store the read data.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Define the RAM array
        reg [DEPTH - 1 : 0] RAM [2**WIDTH-1:0];
        
        // Initialize the RAM contents to 0
        integer i;
        initial begin
            for(i = 0; i < 2**WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
                RAM[i] = {DEPTH{1'b0}};
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for writing data to the RAM
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset the RAM contents to 0
                for(i = 0; i < 2**WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
                    RAM[i] <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
                end
            end else if (write_en) begin
                // Write data to the RAM at the specified address
                RAM[write_addr] <= write_data;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for reading data from the RAM
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset the read data register to 0
                read_data <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
            end else if (read_en) begin
                // Read data from the RAM at the specified address
                read_data <= RAM[read_addr];
            end else begin
                // Clear the read data register if read_en is not active
                read_data <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
